summary: End-to-end backend (25/25 pytest passed) and frontend Playwright testing for Ticketing System covering auth, RBAC, tickets CRUD, bulk-assign, dashboard, comments, activity, and full UI flows for Admin/RA/DQ roles.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: ticket_id generation uses count_documents which is not concurrency-safe; could produce duplicate ticket_ids under load. Consider an atomic counter collection (findOneAndUpdate $inc).
server.py: GET /api/tickets/{id} has no role-based access check - any authenticated user (including RA) can read any ticket by ID if they know it.
server.py: get_current_user always returns 403 if user.status != Active, but this also blocks legitimate expired-token edge cases; OK functionally.
server.py: secure=False on cookie + same-site lax; acceptable for preview but flag for production hardening.
Frontend: token also stored in localStorage which negates httpOnly cookie benefit (XSS exposure); consider relying on cookie-only auth.
server.py is 610 lines and growing; consider splitting into routers/contacts.py, routers/tickets.py, etc.
seed_data_creation: Tests created tickets TKT-1001..TKT-1007 and a TEST contact (now Inactive). No cleanup needed for preview.
